$comment: Shared case set for the oscal-props carriage predicate (ADR-0014 §3.3). Go (ValidCarriedProp) and TypeScript (validCarriedProp) both read it, and both suites additionally validate each entry as a one-item array against shared/oscal-props.schema.json, so the predicate and the schema are pinned to the same verdict. Carriage is per-entry tolerant: an invalid entry is dropped and its valid siblings are kept.

cases.label: minimal entry
cases.why: on/name/value are the only required members

cases.label: every member present
cases.why: an entry mirrors all seven members of an OSCAL prop plus on

cases.label: empty value
cases.why: an OSCAL prop value may be empty; only name has a minimum length

cases.label: on outside the enum
cases.why: on names the OSCAL object the prop hung on: finding, observation or risk

cases.label: on not a string
cases.why: on is a string

cases.label: on absent
cases.why: without on the exporter cannot place the prop back on its object

cases.label: name absent
cases.why: name is required

cases.label: name empty
cases.why: an OSCAL prop name is a non-empty token

cases.label: name not a string
cases.why: name is a string

cases.label: value absent
cases.why: value is required

cases.label: value not a string
cases.why: value is a string, carried verbatim

cases.label: numeric ns
cases.why: a non-string optional would reach the emitted OSCAL prop as a non-string

cases.label: null ns
cases.why: an optional member is present exactly when it is a string

cases.label: numeric class
cases.why: class is a string when present

cases.label: object group
cases.why: group is a string when present

cases.label: array uuid
cases.why: uuid is a string when present

cases.label: boolean remarks
cases.why: remarks is a string when present

cases.label: unknown member
cases.why: the tag admits no member beyond on plus OSCAL's seven, so a typo is a malformed entry rather than silent data loss

cases.label: entry is a string
cases.why: each entry is an object

cases.label: entry is null
cases.why: each entry is an object

cases.label: entry is an array
cases.why: each entry is an object, not a positional tuple

cases.label: entry is a number
cases.why: each entry is an object

cases.label: empty optional
cases.why: an empty optional is a string the schema admits; both languages then treat it as absent, so nothing re-emits an empty ns
